bio: Prepare to be hit for six! Enjoy a guided tour, match tickets and an Afternoon Tea for two at the iconic Kia Oval cricket ground.  Enjoy the ultimate day out at the iconic Kia Oval Cricket Ground, catching Surrey Cricket Club in action, venturing behind the scenes of the stadium and savouring a mouth-watering sparkling Afternoon Tea.  Begin with a guided tour of the legendary sporting venue, learning all about the history and day-to-day running of the grounds. Stop by the pitch and take position on the outfield, test your hand at cricket commentary in the official commentary box, take a peek inside the Committee Room and check out the collection of memorabilia showcased in the Member's Pavilion.  Once finished, get seated for the match and cheer on Surrey Cricket Club. Top it all off by savouring a scrumptious afternoon tea for two, served overlooking the pitch.
